# FROZEN pre-cure shape of the dispatch-brief store, kept as data so the rung
# has a real instance of the class to judge. The live module now wraps the cut
# in a notice that names both sizes; this is what it looked like when the cut
# copy was stored and every reader presented it as the brief.
MESSAGE_BODY_CAP = 4000


def store_brief(row, message, ledger):
    row["message_body"] = message[:MESSAGE_BODY_CAP]
    ledger.append(row)
    return row
